d:
Sodhi organizes a secret "party-sharty" at Nashila Dhaba. To slip away, the society men concoct elaborate excuses at home—Jethalal lies that a friend's father passed away (and is forced by Bapuji to dress in white funeral clothes), while Taarak claims he has an urgent career meeting with his boss.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
